name: Create AI Agent Rule Creation Kit

description: Created AI agent rule creation kit: templates/rule_template.py (55 lines), skills/create-rule/SKILL.md (full reference), benchmark-rules.sh (5-check validation). Validated with PRINT002 end-to-end: all 5 checks pass.

asi.hypothesis: Three-file kit enables AI agents to write correct rules

name: Add impactful semantic rules to smart-linter for FastAPI

description: Baseline: 12 rules, 3 findings on 2 real FastAPI repos, 0 false positives. ERR001 finds 2 on fastapi-benchmark, MAIN001 finds 1 on fastapi-boiler.

asi.hypothesis: Baseline measurement of current rules on real FastAPI repos
asi.findings: Only ERR001 (2) and MAIN001 (1) fire on real code. Many existing rules (ASYNC001, SEC001-003, etc.) don't fire because real repos avoid those patterns
asi.gaps: Need rules that catch real-world patterns: unauthenticated endpoints, missing response_model, sync DB in async, lost exception context

description: Added SEC004: Unauthenticated mutation endpoint detection. Found 3 real security issues (fastapi-benchmark private.py:create_user, fastapi-boiler tasks.py:create_task and users.py:write_user). Fixed false positives on get_current_active_superuser pattern. 17 tests, 0 false positives.

asi.hypothesis: SEC004 detects mutation endpoints without auth deps
asi.findings: 3 real issues found: private.py:create_user (no auth user creation), tasks.py:create_task (rate-limited but no auth), users.py:write_user (public signup)
asi.bug_fix: get_current_active_superuser substring matching was broken - added full name to AUTH_DEPENDENCY_SUBSTRINGS
asi.false_positive_risk: write_user in boiler is a signup endpoint but doesn't match public patterns since URL is just '/user'
